persistent_state.state_description: The receiver adds an optional source-bound supplement-state.json file alongside the existing Playbook cache. It is an additive, replaceable overlay projection: prior versions ignore the unknown file, and the current version can discard or rebuild it from the verified supplement asset without a database migration.
